verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack states a no-training policy or a training opt-out. The only indirect route is data control: Bolna can be self-hosted on your own servers for private deployments (bolna-docs-9), it is an open-source framework (bolna-gh-1), and it can route to a custom OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint you control (bolna-docs-11), which together could keep call data away from vendor-side training. Missing for 10: an explicit policy that customer data is not used for model training, a documented opt-out control for the hosted platform, and clarity on whether third-party STT/TTS/LLM providers may train on data.
